about: Acknowledgements split-out faces. Photos only from official/professional pages that name the person with a matching affiliation; otherwise initials. crop = [cx, cy, side]: face centre (fractions of width/height), square side (fraction of the shorter edge). `url` (the director asked that a click on a name or headshot open the person's own website) = the person's own site first, else their official profile page; absent = unlinked. `size` (optional) = output pixels for the small bullet faces; `mask: circle` (logos) = cut a round badge out of its white background; `dark_filter` (logos) = a CSS filter the page applies so a mark drawn for white reads on the dark plate. Built by build_headshots.py → R2 acks/people_v2/<slug>.jpg|png. `prefix` (optional) = the R2 prefix this tile was baked into when it is not the default acks/people_v2 (new faces go to a new prefix; never re-upload over v2).
